name: Templates
description: Saved setups the organization reuses, after Opendate's template inventory. An event template holds an event's setup (description, capacity, doors and length relative to the start, other settings, ticket types with prices, fee rules); making an event from one gives a draft with all of it. A note template is a booking note body to add to a show. A rental invoice template holds a venue rental's lines (fixed or per head), deposits and taxes; rental invoices are made from them (Rental invoices). Event templates need `events:read` / `events:write`, the others `booking:read` / `booking:write`. Opendate's underscore names (/v1/event_templates, /v1/note_templates, /v1/rental_invoice_templates) answer too. Money is in cents.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Only this status (or all, the default).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-10000 (default 1). A page past the end answers an empty data array.

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Rows per page, 1-200 (default 50).

endpoints.description: From the fields below, or from one of your events: send from_event_id (and optionally name) to save that event's setup (settings, ticket types and prices, active event fee rules, doors and length relative to its start). At most 100 per organization.

parameters.name: from_event_id
parameters.description: Save this event's setup as the template.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The template's name, 1-100 characters. Required on create.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: active (default) or archived. Archived templates stay listed but can't make events.

parameters.name: event_name
parameters.description: The new event's name (else the template's name), at most 200 characters.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: The new event's description, at most 20000 characters.

parameters.name: capacity
parameters.description: The event's capacity (total_tickets); else the sum of the ticket types.

parameters.name: doors_offset_minutes
parameters.description: Doors open this many minutes before the start (0-1440).

parameters.name: duration_minutes
parameters.description: The show ends this many minutes after the start (1-10080).

parameters.name: event_fields
parameters.description: Other event settings, copied to the event: timezone, currency, venue_name, venue_location, venue_address, primary_performer_name, performer_names, category, genres, subgenres, image_url, purchase_limits, summary, description_md, faq, video_url, min_age, refund_policy, policy_notes, format, what_to_bring, noindex, allow_holder_release, release_cutoff_hours, accessibility, door_name_checkin, exos_venue_id, exos_room_id. Any other key is refused.

parameters.name: tiers
parameters.description: Up to 50 ticket types: { name, description?, price_cents, capacity, ticket_type (paid | free | donation), visibility (public | hidden), sort_order?, accessible?, accessible_note? }. Prices are the all-in price in cents. ticket_types is accepted too.

parameters.name: fee_rules
parameters.description: Up to 25 event fee rules (docs/fees.md): { name, recipient?, kind (passed_on | absorbed), calc (fixed | percent), amount_cents | percent, cap_cents?, per (ticket | order), taxable?, applies_to_addons? }. A per-order fee must be absorbed.

parameters.name: inherit_org_fees
parameters.description: Whether events made from it also take the organization's fee rules (default true).

responses.description: A bad field; the message names it.

example.error: tiers[0].ticket_type must be paid, free or donation
at most 100 event templates per organization

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template.

responses.description: No such id in your organization.

endpoints.summary: Create an event from a template
endpoints.description: A DRAFT event with the template's settings, description, capacity and ticket types, its event fee rules, and doors and end times worked out from starts_at. Publish it with POST /v1/events/:id/publish. The key's creator must be an owner or manager.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The template.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The event's name (else the template's event_name or name).

parameters.name: starts_at
parameters.description: The start; doors and end follow from the template. Without it the draft has no dates.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA zone, overriding the template's.

parameters.name: exos_venue_id
parameters.description: One of your venues (GET /v1/venues). venue_id is accepted too.

parameters.name: exos_room_id
parameters.description: A room of that venue. room_id is accepted too.
